# One complete runtime layer per version/platform, shared by all role/session workers.
FROM node:24.13.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:4660b1ca8b28d6d1906fd644abe34b2ed81d15434d26d845ef0aced307cf4b6f
ARG DSH_VERSION=0.2.2-rc.1
RUN npm install --global --omit=dev @deepseek-ai/dsh@${DSH_VERSION} \
    && dsh --version \
    && npm cache clean --force
RUN apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends ca-certificates bubblewrap \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY permissions/backends/dsh /opt/devdesk/dsh-policy
# Load immutable native addons from the image; restricted profiles may keep /tmp noexec.
ENV DSH_HOME=/state/dsh DSH_MAX_TOKENS_AS_SUCCESS=false NARB_DISABLE_NATIVE_CACHE=1
USER 1000:1000
WORKDIR /work
ENTRYPOINT ["dsh", "--profile", "sdk"]

#!/bin/bash
# Public DSH runnerCommand seam. Docker already owns the outer PID namespace.
# Keep a private tool PID namespace, but use an empty /proc: Docker's default
# masked proc submounts intentionally prevent mounting another proc filesystem.
# No parent environment, harness state or coordinator policy is exposed to tools.
set -euo pipefail
profile=()
while (($#)) && [[ "$1" != -- ]]; do
  if [[ "$1" == --proc ]]; then
    [[ $# -ge 2 && "$2" == /proc ]] || exit 64
    profile+=(--tmpfs /proc)
    shift 2
  else
    profile+=("$1")
    shift
  fi
done
[[ $# -gt 1 && "$1" == -- ]] || exit 64
shift
exec /usr/bin/bwrap --unshare-net "${profile[@]}" --tmpfs /state --tmpfs /run/devdesk -- "$@"
